name: com.eventstatapp/eventstatapp
title: Eventstatapp
description: Live race-day status from Eventstatapp: find events, current status, race schedules and updates.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Lists upcoming and ongoing events with live status pages on Eventstatapp, soonest first. Optionally search by name or location words and limit to a date range. Returns each event's slug, dates, location, current status and links.

query.description: Words to look for in the event name or location, e.g. "marathon" or "Richmond". Leave out to list all.

from_date.description: Only events still running on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD).

to_date.description: Only events starting on or before this day (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: get_event_status
tools.description: Current public status of one event (GREEN go / YELLOW caution / RED stop / PENDING no update yet) with the organizer's headline and message, every race's schedule and status, and the 5 newest public updates.

slug.description: The event's slug: the last part of its status page address, e.g. riverside-10k for eventstatapp.com/e/riverside-10k.

tools.name: get_event_updates
tools.description: The public announcements an event's organizer has posted, newest first (up to 50).

slug.description: The event's slug: the last part of its status page address, e.g. riverside-10k for eventstatapp.com/e/riverside-10k.

limit.description: Most updates to return, newest first (1–50, default 20).
